doctrine: proof events advance maturity; repository size and activity do not

entries.name: Turbo Foundry
entries.north_star: Make the ecosystem compound without duplicating ownership or rewriting evidence
entries.next_proof: Automatically validate more cross-repo ownership/contracts and proof claims

entries.name: Earth Now
entries.north_star: Truthful cinematic answer to what Earth is doing right now
entries.next_proof: Add a high-value real observation layer without weakening provenance

entries.name: Window / Seeker
entries.north_star: Location in to closest legitimate public view out
entries.next_proof: Deploy broad provider-backed discovery and resolve useful verified views beyond the curated registry

entries.name: Portal
entries.north_star: The other internet: every door earns the click and the site feels like one world
entries.next_proof: Complete a reliable end-to-end traveler journey across stations with persistent consequences

entries.name: Portal Connection / Campfire
entries.north_star: Real lightweight human connection without fabricated presence
entries.next_proof: Connect two real browsers through the first constrained presence or signal session

entries.name: EDGE / VALUE
entries.north_star: Find what matters before it becomes obvious
entries.next_proof: Accumulate prospective labeled outcomes and compare VALUE with frozen simple baselines

entries.name: Seldon
entries.north_star: Predict forward, freeze what was knowable, score reality and learn from surprise
entries.next_proof: Accumulate a meaningful prospective forecast history with calibration against simple baselines

entries.name: Oracle / Proof of Edge
entries.north_star: Reject weak trades and surface only setups that earn capital testing
entries.next_proof: Frozen unseen paper-forward evidence clears or fails the declared gate after realistic costs

entries.name: Oracle Q
entries.north_star: Test quantum and quantum-inspired optimization against the identical classical problem
entries.next_proof: Walk-forward emulator or quantum-inspired result beats or fails to beat the frozen classical baseline

entries.name: Base One
entries.north_star: Discover and reproducibly analyze actionable property candidates
entries.next_proof: Surface a genuinely actionable candidate through scout, enrichment and financing analysis

entries.name: MINT
entries.north_star: Turn legitimate opportunities into independently verified settled spendable capital
entries.next_proof: Record the first independently verified settled dollar and repeat the workflow

entries.name: Sovereign Core
entries.north_star: One provider-neutral intelligence platform with many bounded bodies and agents
entries.next_proof: Multiple bodies or agents pass the same canonical protocol, capability and evaluation suite

entries.name: Sovereign Offline
entries.north_star: Useful intelligence with external networking unavailable
entries.next_proof: Pass reproducible network-denial operation with local model, memory/RAG, index and UI

entries.name: Sovereign Online
entries.north_star: Independent replaceable-model online AI body
entries.next_proof: Serve sustained useful inference through the Core contract with evaluation evidence

entries.name: Victory Impact
entries.north_star: Transparent humanitarian and restoration donation, governance and disbursement infrastructure
entries.next_proof: Complete donation to treasury routing to authorized disbursement to public proof

entries.name: Victory Identity
entries.north_star: Challenge-signature identity with server-side roles and policy
entries.next_proof: Complete testnet challenge, signature, verified address and policy authorization with negative tests

entries.name: Fonzi
entries.north_star: One portable character identity whose representation changes across worlds
entries.next_proof: Freeze identity schema and prove control and provenance across Victory and Portal

entries.name: Soul Key
entries.north_star: Test presence recognition as conventional signals are progressively removed
entries.next_proof: Pass or fail the next preregistered blinded ablation gate and preserve the result

entries.name: Turbo Turtle
entries.north_star: Recover the original artifact before calling any replacement canonical
entries.next_proof: Locate and fingerprint the original source, build or artifact

entries.name: RYLN AI
entries.north_star: Preserve legacy capability until deliberate review and migration
entries.next_proof: Inventory actual behavior and decide what deserves migration
